pages.name: kicker
pages.label: Kicker
pages.hint: Small uppercase line above the title. Teal under the home wordmark; muted above an internal page's heading.

pages.name: heading
pages.label: Statement heading
pages.hint: The 56px statement heading. On the home page this also gates the whole dark band — leave it blank and the band, quote and band body do not render.

pages.name: lead
pages.label: Lead
pages.hint: The 24px line that closes the home statement block. Home page only.

pages.name: intro
pages.label: Intro
pages.hint: Standfirst beside the title in an internal page's two-column header. Internal pages only — the home page ignores it.

pages.name: bandBody
pages.label: Band body
pages.hint: Body copy set beside the heading inside the dark band. Internal pages only.

pages.name: cards
pages.label: Action cards
pages.hint: Home page only. The grid is three columns wide and deliberately holds two cards — the empty third column is part of the design, so do not add a filler card.

pages.name: showContactButton
pages.label: Show contact button
pages.hint: Renders a mailto button addressed to the contact email in Settings.
